title: 三相连接与三相电机
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/188_三相连接与三相电机.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/188_三相连接与三相电机/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三相实验台前，台上三盏灯和一台三相调压器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a powered off three phase training bench with three lamps and a three phase variable transformer, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第二十六课：三相连接与三相电机。

shots.scene: 阿杰想直接把星形改成三角形，不降电压
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches toward the lamp terminals on a bench whose three phase switch is on, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰：星形改三角形，直接改就行？

shots.scene: 王老师拉下三极开关，摇手
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator pulls the three pole switch off and raises a hand, a crossed out live rewiring icon.
shots.narration: 王老师：先回零断电，还要降电压！

shots.scene: 小研拿着计算好的电压表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a blank calculation sheet beside a three phase circuit diagram, nodding.
shots.narration: 小研：接法不同，灯承受的电压不同。

shots.scene: 测两种接法的线量和相量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a star connection and a delta connection side by side with voltmeter and ammeter icons. No text.
shots.narration: 实测星形、三角形的线量和相量。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: measured values flowing into a comparison icon with a root three symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 找出线量与相量的关系，动手验证。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single phase socket and a three phase supply, the three phase voltage bar much taller, an electric shock warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 三相线电压380伏，比单相高得多。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a current path through a body with a larger danger meter for three phase. No text.
shots.narration: 一旦触电，后果更严重。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a training badge, two students at a bench and a teacher icon beside them. No text.
shots.narration: 按准入要求，两人以上、老师指导。

shots.scene: 安全措施做足，接头牢固
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a circuit diagram followed exactly, firm terminal joints checked. No text.
shots.narration: 安全措施做足，按图接线，接头牢固。

shots.scene: 两只交流电压表、两只电流表、三灯
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two alternating current voltmeters, two ammeters and three identical lamps on a bench. No text.
shots.narration: 两只电压表、两只电流表、三盏同规格灯。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: plug leads checked with a continuity icon on a powered off bench. No text.
shots.narration: 导线先查通断，完好才用。

shots.scene: 三相电源经熔断器和三极开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a three phase supply passing through three fuses and a triple pole switch on the wall. No text.
shots.narration: 三相电源经熔断器和三极开关引出。

shots.scene: 调压器上排输入，下排输出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a three phase variable transformer with an upper row of input terminals and a lower row of output terminals. No text.
shots.narration: 调压器上排输入、下排输出，从输出接起。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a neat circuit diagram with meter and lamp rating icons beside each component. No text.
shots.narration: 电路图画清楚，标明仪表和灯的额定值。

shots.scene: 【实拍】三相调压器旋钮回到零位
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand turning the knob of a three phase variable transformer to the zero position, the bench switched off.
shots.narration: 电源接调压器输入，旋钮先回零。

shots.scene: 三相电压从零平滑升高
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three voltage bars rising together smoothly as the knob turns slowly. No text.
shots.narration: 调压器让三相电压从零慢慢升高。

shots.scene: 三个线圈尾端接在一起
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three coils with their end terminals joined at one common point, the start terminals left free. No text.
shots.narration: 星形：三相的尾端接在一起。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the common point of a star connection highlighted with a star icon. No text.
shots.narration: 这个公共点叫中性点，也叫星点。

shots.scene: 【实拍】三只灯座尾端用导线连成星点
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands linking the end terminals of three lamp holders together with short plug leads on a powered off bench.
shots.narration: 三盏同规格灯当负载，尾端连成星点。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltmeter connected between two line conductors marked one and two. No text.
shots.narration: 任意两根相线之间，是线电压。

shots.scene: 相电压：相线与中性点之间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltmeter connected between one line conductor and the neutral point. No text.
shots.narration: 相线和中性点之间，是相电压。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student confusing two voltmeter positions, a question mark, then a check mark after a teacher icon explains. No text.
shots.narration: 很多人会混，做实验前一定分清。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: output one of the variable transformer through an ammeter to the start of phase A, outputs two and three to phases B and C. No text.
shots.narration: 输出一经电流表接A1，二接B1，三接C1。

shots.scene: 电压表一测线压一测相压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one voltmeter between two lines and another between a line and the star point. No text.
shots.narration: 一只电压表测线电压，一只测相电压。

shots.scene: 星形线电流就是相电流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one current arrow passing from the line straight into the phase coil, the same value. No text.
shots.narration: 星形里，线电流就是相电流。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single ammeter in one line measuring both line and phase current. No text.
shots.narration: 所以一只电流表，就能同时测出两者。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phasor triangle with two phase voltages and the line voltage, a root three ratio. No text.
shots.narration: 线电压是相电压的根号三倍。

shots.scene: 开关断开、调压器最小时接线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a triple pole switch open and the knob at zero while hands wire the bench. No text.
shots.narration: 接线时开关断开，调压器在零位。

shots.scene: 查过线再合闸，盯着电压表升
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a teacher check icon, the switch closed, then the knob turning slowly while the line voltmeter rises. No text.
shots.narration: 老师查过再合闸，盯着线电压表慢升。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an upper and lower meter scale with the matching range highlighted, values written in a table. No text.
shots.narration: 按所接量程读刻度，记下三个读数。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the phase voltage reading multiplied by root three compared with the line voltage reading, nearly equal. No text.
shots.narration: 相电压乘根号三，和线电压比一比。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the knob returned to zero first, then the switch opened, numbered order. No text.
shots.narration: 读完先回零，再断开开关。

shots.scene: 【实拍】断电后把灯座接线端子拧紧
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand tightening lamp holder terminal screws with an insulated screwdriver on a powered off bench.
shots.narration: 断电时把接线端子拧紧。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the star point joint firmly connected and checked, a loose star point crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 星形的中性点，一定要接牢。

shots.scene: 三灯明暗不一，回零断电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three lamps with uneven brightness, one too bright, a hand returning the knob to zero and opening the switch. No text.
shots.narration: 三灯明暗不一，马上回零断电查。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three coils connected end to start in sequence forming a closed triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 三角形：一相的尾，接下一相的头。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a closed delta loop with no common neutral point. No text.
shots.narration: 首尾相接成闭环，没有中性点。

shots.scene: 【实拍】断电时把灯座首尾相接
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of hands linking the end of one lamp holder to the start of the next with plug leads on a powered off bench, forming a loop.
shots.narration: 调压器三路输出接三个首端。

shots.scene: 三角形线电压就是相电压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a voltmeter across one delta phase showing the same value as between two lines. No text.
shots.narration: 三角形里，线电压就是相电压。

shots.scene: 一表测线流，一表测相流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one ammeter in a line conductor and another ammeter inside one phase of the delta. No text.
shots.narration: 两只电流表，分别测线电流和相电流。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phasor diagram with two phase currents combining into a line current, a root three ratio. No text.
shots.narration: 线电流是相电流的根号三倍。

shots.scene: 改接前调压器回零、断三极开关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the knob at zero and the triple pole switch opened before any rewiring. No text.
shots.narration: 改接前：调压器回零，断开三极开关。

shots.scene: 【实拍】三极开关断开并挂禁止合闸牌
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a hand hanging a blank do not switch on tag on an opened triple pole switch handle.
shots.narration: 开关处挂牌，防止别人误合闸。

shots.scene: 用合格验电器确认无电
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tested voltage detector confirming no voltage on all three lines, a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 用合格的验电器，确认确实无电。

shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator checks the delta wiring on the powered off bench before allowing power on.
shots.narration: 改完请老师检查，同意后再合闸。

shots.scene: 三角形每盏灯承受线电压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lamp in a delta connection directly across two line conductors, a voltage arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 三角形时，每盏灯直接承受线电压。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lamp receiving too high a voltage, a burst bulb icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 改三角形不降压，灯泡会烧坏甚至炸裂。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the knob turning only partway, the line voltage bar stopping at the lamp rated value. No text.
shots.narration: 所以只把线电压升到灯的额定值以内。

shots.scene: 先算好电压，请老师确认
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calculation sheet with a lamp rating icon, a teacher thumbs up icon. No text.
shots.narration: 通电前先算好电压，请老师确认。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two ammeters with different readings, the line current larger. No text.
shots.narration: 线电流和相电流，读数不一样。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: dim lamps in star at a low voltage beside brighter lamps in delta. No text.
shots.narration: 电压不高，三角形的灯就明显更亮。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the knob back at zero, the switch opened and a data table filled. No text.
shots.narration: 读完回零断闸，把数据填进表。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a star icon with an equal current sign and a root three voltage sign. No text.
shots.narration: 星形：电流相等，线电压是相电压√3倍。

shots.scene: 三角形：电压相等，电流√3倍
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a delta icon with an equal voltage sign and a root three current sign. No text.
shots.narration: 三角形：电压相等，线电流是相电流√3倍。

shots.scene: 常见说法：星形高电压小电流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a star icon beside a high voltage low current icon. No text.
shots.narration: 常见说法：星形多用于高电压小电流。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a delta icon beside a low voltage high current icon. No text.
shots.narration: 三角形，多用于大电流低电压。

shots.scene: 按负载额定电压选接法
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a motor nameplate icon pointing to the matching star or delta connection. No text.
shots.narration: 实际按负载额定电压，选星形或三角形。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a delta connection with three line conductors only. No text.
shots.narration: 三角形是三相三线制。

shots.scene: 星形引出中性线：三相四线制
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a star connection with three line conductors and a neutral conductor from the star point. No text.
shots.narration: 星形引出中性线，就是三相四线制。

shots.scene: 负载不平衡，中性线有电流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three unequal lamps in star, a current arrow flowing in the neutral conductor. No text.
shots.narration: 三相负载不平衡，中性线有电流。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand touching the neutral conductor crossed out, an electric shock warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 中性线不是安全线，不能徒手碰。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the supply switched off before the neutral conductor is disconnected. No text.
shots.narration: 拆中性线，也要先断开电源。

shots.scene: 三相电进定子产生旋转磁场
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a motor stator with three windings fed by three phases, a rotating magnetic field arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 三相电通进定子，产生旋转磁场。

shots.scene: 磁场切割转子，感应电流
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: field lines sweeping across rotor bars, small induced current arrows in the bars. No text.
shots.narration: 磁场切割转子，感应出电动势和电流。

shots.scene: 转子转起来，电能变机械能
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the rotor turning and driving a shaft, an energy arrow from electrical to mechanical. No text.
shots.narration: 转子转起来，电能变成机械能。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a transformer icon with a rotating arrow beside a motor icon. No text.
shots.narration: 原理是电磁感应，像一台旋转的变压器。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three phase sine waves feeding a stator, the combined field vector rotating smoothly. No text.
shots.narration: 三相电进定子，就有旋转磁场。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the combined flux vector length about one and a half times one phase maximum. No text.
shots.narration: 合成磁通约为每相最大值的1.5倍。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the rotating field inducing voltage in the rotor, an arrow from field to rotor. No text.
shots.narration: 它正是转子电动势的来源。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a rotating field arrow with a speed dial, the rotor slightly behind it. No text.
shots.narration: 同步转速，是旋转磁场的转速。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a formula icon with frequency and pole pairs, a two pole and a four pole motor beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 等于六十乘频率，除以极对数。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a two pole field at three thousand revolutions per minute and a four pole field at fifteen hundred. No text.
Diagram: the rotor speed dial slightly lower than the field speed dial. No text.
shots.narration: 它不是转子的实际转速。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the difference between field speed and rotor speed divided by field speed, a percent icon. No text.
shots.narration: 转差率：同步转速减转子转速，除同步。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small slip value shown as a percent on a gauge. No text.
shots.narration: 通常用百分数表示。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: rotor frequency equal to slip times stator frequency, a small wave inside the rotor. No text.
shots.narration: 转子频率，等于转差率乘定子频率。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a generator rotor winding fed with direct current through slip rings, a magnetic field around it. No text.
shots.narration: 同步发电机：转子绕组通直流励磁。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a prime mover turning the rotor, the field rotating with it inside the stator. No text.
shots.narration: 原动机带着转子转，磁场跟着转。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three stator windings with three phase voltage waves coming out. No text.
shots.narration: 定子里，就感应出三相电动势。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an equation icon with frequency, flux, turns and two winding factors. No text.
shots.narration: 电动势与频率、磁通、匝数有关。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a direct current machine commutator with segments and brushes, an alternating wave turning into a direct line. No text.
shots.narration: 换向器，又叫机械整流器。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: alternating current in the armature coils converted to direct current at the brushes. No text.
shots.narration: 把绕组里的交流，变成直流输出。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a motor shaft coupling covered by a guard, an uncovered spinning shaft crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 转轴联轴器要有防护罩，不拆不跨。

shots.scene: 束发扎袖，不戴手套碰转动件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person with tied hair and fitted sleeves, loose sleeves, a scarf and gloves near a spinning shaft crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 束发扎袖，摘围巾，不戴手套碰转件。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand grabbing a spinning shaft to stop it crossed out, an emergency stop button checked. No text.
shots.narration: 绝不用手去刹停转轴，按急停。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a motor switched off with its shaft still coasting, a timer icon until it stops. No text.
shots.narration: 断电后电机还会惯性转，停稳再靠近。

shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a generator shaft turning with its output terminals marked by an electric shock warning sign. No text.
shots.narration: 发电机一转，端子就带电。

shots.scene: 异响过热缺相，立即停机
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a motor with a noise icon, heat waves and one missing phase, a hand pressing stop. No text.
shots.narration: 异响、过热、缺相，立即停机报告。

shots.scene: 回零断电接线，查后升压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a knob at zero, an opened switch, a teacher check and a slow rising voltage bar. No text.
shots.narration: 回零断电接线，老师查后缓慢升压。

shots.scene: 星形电压√3倍，三角形电流√3倍
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a star icon with a root three voltage sign and a delta icon with a root three current sign. No text.
shots.narration: 星形线压√3倍，三角形线流√3倍。

shots.scene: 接法配额定，旋转件防卷入
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lamp rating icon matched to a delta connection and a guarded motor shaft. No text.
shots.narration: 接法配额定电压；旋转电机防卷入。

shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a large wattmeter model and an energy saving lamp, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：单相与三相功率测量。
